title: Leakage-Safe Empirical Benchmarking of EEG-Based Machine Learning Pipelines for Dementia Classification
abstract: arXiv:2609.22092v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a low-cost and non-invasive signal source for dementia screening, yet existing EEG-based studies remain difficult to compare because preprocessing, EEG segmentation, feature design, classifier choice, and validation protocols vary across studies and are often evaluated in isolation. This variability limits the derivation of robust pipeline recommendations. This paper presents a leakage-safe empirical benchmark for resting-state EEG-based dementia classification and uses it to identify a practical best-practice pipeline. Using the public OpenNeuro ds004504 dataset, the benchmark evaluates artifact correction, fixed-length EEG segmentation, training-only augmentation, multi-domain feature extraction, fold-internal feature selection, classical machine-learning (ML) classifiers, subject-level aggregation, and interpretation under leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) validation. translated_title: 面向痴呆症分类的基于脑电图的机器学习流水线的防泄漏实证基准测试
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）是一种低成本、无创的痴呆症筛查信号源，然而现有的基于EEG的研究仍然难以相互比较，因为预处理、EEG分段、特征设计、分类器选择和验证方案在不同研究中各不相同，且往往被孤立地评估。这种差异性限制了得出稳健的流水线推荐。本文提出了一个用于静息态EEG痴呆症分类的防数据泄漏实证基准，并利用它来确定一种实用的最佳实践流水线。该基准使用公开的OpenNeuro ds004504数据集，在留一受试者交叉验证（LOSO）下评估了伪迹校正、固定长度EEG分段、仅在训练集上进行的增强、多域特征提取、折内特征选择、经典机器学习分类器、受试者级聚合以及模型可解释性。在此基准中表现最佳的流水线……（摘要原文此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一个防数据泄漏的静息态EEG痴呆症分类实证基准，在留一受试者验证下系统评估从伪迹校正到分类器的完整机器学习流水线各环节，以确定实用的最佳实践方案。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a leakage-safe empirical benchmark for resting-state EEG-based dementia classification, systematically evaluating complete machine learning pipelines under leave-one-subject-out validation to identify a practical best-practice pipeline.
